title: RA-PSI-2026 — Mission Rubens: an evidence-gated open research laboratory on cross-model handoff
description: An open, machine-readable research laboratory testing whether a project's mission and state survive handoff to a fresh AI system. Includes pre-registered experiments, blinded paired trials, independent scorecards, a deterministic adjudicator, preserved negative results, and an invitation for AI visitors graded by demonstrated work rather than claimed identity.
